findings.claim: The analysis bases the release plan on adapting packaging and release files that the packet declares missing.
findings.evidence: analysis.md recommends adapting `integration-binaries.js`, `before-pack.js`, `after-pack.js`, and `RELEASES.md`, but `cited_paths` says: `MISSING  RELEASES.md`, `MISSING  after-pack.js`, `MISSING  before-pack.js`, `MISSING  integration-binaries.js`.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve the actual repository/worktree paths for these files and cite existing paths, or change the recommendation to first create the missing packaging/release artifacts.

findings.claim: The candidate evaluation relies on source paths outside the supplied file tree, so the stated existing Electron, packaging, workflow, and landing-site seams are unverifiable from the packet.
findings.evidence: Candidates cite `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/worktrees/the-boss-uar/electron.vite.config.ts`, `/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/worktrees/the-boss-uar/.github/workflows/the-boss-release.yml`, and `Know-Me-Tools/boss-landing-spot scripts/sync-release.mjs`; the supplied file tree contains no `.github/`, no `electron.vite.config.ts`, no `build/integration-artifacts.json`, and no `boss-landing-spot` path.
